senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (= סעסע, cmp. סער, שׂער; cmp. זָאזָא) bristle, awn or beard of grain.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 17b:5">Ḥull. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>דמיא לס׳</he> (Ar. <he>לססא</he>) if the slaughtering knife is rough like a bristle of &c.—Pl. <he>סָאסִין</he>, constr. <he>סָאסֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:11:1">Koh. R. to IX, 11</cite> <he>שהיה רץ על ס׳ שיבולין וכ׳</he> (not <he>שיבוליא</he>; some ed. <he>שָׂאסֵי</he>) he ran over the ears of standing grain, and they were not broken.
